systems.system: AI speech-to-text for court hearing minutes

EGY.note: The AI runs inside the courts' hearing system, a sector system, not general administration.

facts.fact: The ICT and Justice ministers launched the remote criminal litigation system at East Alexandria Court, using AI speech-to-text to turn hearings into written minutes.
The ICT Minister said the AI speech-to-text has achieved an accuracy rate exceeding 96%.

The ICT Minister said the speech-recognition and AI speech-to-text system was entirely developed by MCIT's Applied Innovation Center and designed by Egyptian engineers, and it was launched at East Alexandria Court.

EGY.note: Court hearing system; fibre and video units in police stations are connectivity only, no station record stated.
